name: alternate punching
display_role_basis: Source-informed artistic visible load proxies; cardiovascular system is not a surface muscle. Source target/secondary labels are retained, not rewritten; no measured activation claim.
source_instructions: Stand with a staggered stance and fists up.
Punch forward with one arm, rotating your torso slightly.
Pull it back as you punch with the other.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

phases.label: Right punch and retraction; left punch and retraction

interpretation: Authored slowed five-second demonstration, not a claimed source tempo or clinical/force/stability certification. Fixed staggered stance, closed guard fists and alternating forward punches;17-degree soft elbow at extension,8-degree upper torso rotation; no strike target or impact props. Source30–60second workout interval retained separately.
